title: Faithful flatness, ind-etaleness and spectrum limit of a presented ring colimit
statement: Let I be a small preorder in the universe of the commutative rings D_i and F. Coherent transitions, compatible inclusions D_i→F and a ring-map universal property define a categorical colimit. If I is filtered and compatible maps R→D_i are faithfully flat and etale, their induced map R→F is faithfully flat and ind-etale. For any test scheme Z, compatible maps Z→Spec D_i factor uniquely through Spec F.

source.place: 090N faithfully flat filtered colimits; 01YW affine inverse limits; 04AX categorical colimit universal property.

proof.text: Build the ring diagram and its cocone directly from the maps and coherence equations. Apply IsColimit.ofExistsUnique to the given compatible-map universal property. Cocone naturality gives the required transition equations; ring homomorphism extensionality transports uniqueness to categorical morphisms.

The structural maps form a natural transformation from the constant R diagram. Apply the adopted source theorem RingHom.FaithfullyFlat.of_isColimit to this cocone and the faithfully flat maps at every stage. The same diagram, constant-base transformation and colimit cocone supply RingHom.IndEtale.iff_exists with its stagewise etale proofs. No witness is chosen to define a ring or a map: all the diagram and cocone data have already been constructed.

Oppose the colimit cocone. The spectrum functor preserves the resulting limit because it is a right adjoint. For a test scheme and a compatible family, form its cone to the spectrum diagram; naturality is precisely the compatibility equation with reversed arrows. The limit universal property gives the unique factorization, including all projection equations.
